subject: [PATCH v1] memcg: fix cacheline contention between lruvec stat updates and LRU lists

reviews.author: Shakeel Butt
reviews.summary: Approved the patch and suggested that the author take ownership of it and post both patches together in v2.
reviews.raw_body:
On Wed, Oct 21, 2026 at 01:04:36PM -0700, Joanne Koong wrote:
> On Wed, Oct 21, 2026 at 9:12\u202fAM Shakeel Butt <shakeel.butt@linux.dev> wrote:
> >
[...]
> 
> Sounds good, I'll go the layout rearranging route then. I verified on
> the Intel machine that rearranging + the pgdat change gives the same
> results as this v1. Do you want me to include your rearrange patch in
> v2 (with your authorship and signed-off-by) or do you prefer to post
> it yourself and I'll send the pgdat change on top?

You can take the patch and the ownership/authorship as well and post both
patches.

Shakeel

2026-10-21.patch_summary: A fix for cacheline contention between lruvec stat updates and LRU lists, specifically affecting Intel's prefetcher.
